limitations: Initial expected outline, SELF_OCCLUDED and TRUNCATED remain conditional on initial cuboid pose; a wrong initial pose can remove valid observations.
Actual image mask-line intersections do not prove requested physical 3D corner identity. Rounded/virtual cuboid corners, holes, wrong masks and same-colored foreground objects remain risks.
A line covariance describes repeat line-fit precision and correlated shared-edge measurements, not calibrated semantic visibility or total coordinate error.
Strong count is not rank or uniqueness proof; finite four-point starts do not explore every pose basin. Rank/stability guards reduce numerical ambiguity but cannot guarantee accuracy.
Three-point translation retains any upstream rotation error exactly; <=2 fallback retains all upstream error.

External instance/depth source facts are supplied by caller and are not verified by this helper or emitted by the default RGB producer. V1 native/query/source-reference binding is not a full frame/camera identity authentication contract.
For standalone low-level solver use, fixed H must be supplied honestly; production API recomputes it. Do not bypass the API checks for untrusted observations.
Already-seen TEST49 supports exploratory matched replay only. Do not choose a method per frame by GT or declare automatic overall winner from these results.

recommendation: Keep optional fixed config, expose evidence levels/counts/used IDs/initial fallback and output-only completion, retain all baseline anchors, and verify any external occluder records with their independent source. No further source changes or tuning requested for this frozen run.
